title: R&D Tax Incentive base ledger (sketch, not live)
description: One row per entity per income year from the ATO R&D Tax Incentive transparency reports (data.gov.au, CC BY 2.5 AU). Figures are the ATO's, unchanged. General information only, not personal financial advice.

entity_key.description: ACN (9 digits; direct, or digits 3-11 of the ABN when they form a valid ACN), else the 11-digit ABN, else 'name:<NAME>' when the ATO gave no identifier.

company_name.description: Name as printed in the ATO report.

abn.description: 11-digit ABN, zero-padded; null when the ATO gave an ACN.

acn.description: 9-digit ACN: as given, or derived from the ABN when the ABN's last 9 digits pass the ACN checksum.

id_type.description: Which identifier the ATO printed in the ABN/ACN column.

id_checksum_valid.description: ABN modulus-89 or ACN modulus-10 check passed. Not checked against the ABR register.

rd_expenditure.description: AUD. Total R&D expenditure (notional deductions less feedstock adjustments) as first reported.

rd_expenditure_amended.description: AUD. Total amended R&D expenditure when the company amended its claim; null when not amended.

rd_expenditure_effective.description: Amended figure when present, otherwise the reported figure. Use this for totals and trends.

source_report.description: Which yearly ATO report the row came from. A later report supersedes an earlier one for the same entity and income year (late lodgements, amendments).

asx_code.description: Inferred ASX ticker; see listed-matches.json for confidence and flags.

confidence.description: high = exact normalised legal-name match to a public company, or a reviewed override; medium = match after dropping generic words, or a reviewed subsidiary link; low = PTY entity whose name matches or starts with the listed company's name.

abr_check.description: Result of a manual ABN Lookup page check (name and status), when done.

rd_expenditure_effective.description: Income year -> AUD or null when the entity has no row that year.

cagr_pct_2021_22_to_2023_24.description: Two-period CAGR; null when an endpoint is missing or not positive.

files.ledger-YYYY-YY.csv: Same rows as CSV, same column order.
files.sources.json: Source URLs, CKAN metadata, SHA-256, retrieval time.
files.counts.json: Row counts and totals per income year.
files.comparison.json: Completeness check against Rand Advisory and the top-claimant check.
